description: This file provides test support utilities for WebSocket integration testing in a Swift project. It includes mock implementations of WebSocket tasks and sessions, extension methods for protocol resilience, and functions to generate and parse WebSocket message data related to gateway authentication and connection flows.

classes.name: GatewayTestWebSocketTask
classes.description: A mock WebSocket task used for testing WebSocket interactions, supporting message sending, receiving, and connection state management.

classes.name: GatewayTestWebSocketSession
classes.description: A mock WebSocket session that creates and manages multiple mock WebSocket tasks for testing purposes.

methods.name: sendPing
methods.description: A protocol extension method that provides a no-op implementation of sending a ping to keep test doubles resilient to protocol changes.

methods.name: connectChallengeData
methods.description: Generates a JSON-encoded data representing a challenge event with a nonce.

methods.name: connectRequestID
methods.description: Extracts the request ID from a WebSocket message if it is a connect request.

methods.name: connectOkData
methods.description: Constructs a JSON response data indicating a successful connect with protocol details and server info.

methods.name: connectAuthFailureData
methods.description: Creates a JSON data payload for a connection failure due to authentication issues, including optional recommendations for next steps.

methods.name: requestID
methods.description: Extracts a request ID from a WebSocket message, specifically for request messages.

methods.name: requestFrameObject
methods.description: Parses a WebSocket message into a JSON object if possible, used internally by requestID and connectRequestID.

methods.name: okResponseData
methods.description: Builds a JSON response data indicating a successful operation.

methods.name: withLock
methods.description: An extension on NSLock that enforces execution of a closure under a lock, rethrowing any errors.

methods.name: resume
methods.description: Changes the WebSocket task state to running.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Cancels the WebSocket connection with a given close code and reason, updating internal state.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends a WebSocket message, optionally invoking a hook for testing, and records the message index.

methods.name: receive
methods.description: Receives a WebSocket message, either via hook or default behavior for connection simulation.

methods.name: receive(completionHandler:)
methods.description: Registers a callback to handle received messages asynchronously.

methods.name: emitReceiveSuccess
methods.description: Simulates a successful message reception in the test WebSocket task.

methods.name: emitReceiveFailure
methods.description: Simulates a failure during message reception for testing error handling.

methods.name: snapshotCancelCount
methods.description: Returns the number of times the WebSocket task has been canceled.

methods.name: snapshotConnectRequestID
methods.description: Returns the current connect request ID stored in the WebSocket task.

methods.name: snapshotMakeCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of WebSocket tasks created by the session.

methods.name: latestTask
methods.description: Retrieves the most recently created WebSocket task.

methods.name: makeWebSocketTask
methods.description: Creates and registers a new mock WebSocket task for testing, given a URL.
